title: Cookies and Storage
description: Answer a cookie consent banner, save cookie preferences, keep a note for this tab only, and watch the cookies and storage change.

banner.title: We use cookies
banner.text: We use necessary cookies to make this site work. With your permission we would also like to set analytics and marketing cookies. You can change your choice at any time.

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.text: Choose which optional cookies to allow. Necessary cookies are always on.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Needed for the site to work, so they cannot be turned off.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand how the site is used.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Used to show you relevant adverts on other sites.

status.none: You have not made a choice yet
status.custom: You chose which cookies to allow

session.title: Session only
session.explanation: This note is saved in sessionStorage, so it is kept when the page is reloaded but not in a new tab.
session.label: Session note
session.new-tab: Open this page in a new tab

live.title: Current cookies and storage
live.explanation: What this scenario has stored right now. Changes made from outside the page show up after pressing Refresh.

seeding.title: Skip the banner in your tests
seeding.explanation: Set the consent cookie (and any preferences) before the page loads, and the banner never appears. Both examples point at this page.
